reviews.text: Always bring our cat here for her nail clipping. They’re fast efficient and very pleasant to work with. Highly recommend

Yesterday I fell in love with a dog at doggy style who was abandoned. I applied and was approved to adopt her, and was told they would hold her for 24 hours for me, and instructed me to come pick her up at noon today. I went home and purchased everything I would need, and arranged a dog walker for every day this week.

A few minutes before noon, I walked in the store and told the woman who worked there that I was there to pick up the dog, and she told me that the couple currently in the store was adopting her and there was nothing she could do.

I am absolutely crushed right now. This is absolutely unacceptable to do to someone and I really hope you make improvements with your team so that you don’t break someone else’s heart in the future.
Cute little place with VERY good prices!

Karly,

We are sorry to see your review.  Can you contact us at customercare@doggiestylepets.com and let us know what
we can do to better serve you.     We would like more information.

Thank you

Been going to Doggie Style Spruce for as long as they've been there.  For many years,  Jackie groomed my toy poodle Gina. Jackie was always caring & gentle with Gina & always had her looking like a little puff ball! Recently,  at 16years Gina crossed over. I decided to foster for a while & brought my first little foster in for a medical bath. Daniella was amazing with Mercury especially caring with his healing little body.  Everyone that works there is just wonderful, knowledgeable & personable. I can't say enough about the team at this location.

Such a kind and welcoming experience! I popped in this morning while visiting friends from out of town and found myself in a bit of an emergency situation with a dead phone. The manager was incredibly sweet and gracious enough to let me charge my phone, which I truly appreciated!

While I was there, I got to browse some really cute dog clothes, check out their selection of healthy treats, and even learned that they offer the opportunity to walk one of their pups for about 30 minutes. 🐶❤️

What started as a quick stop to charge my phone turned into such a pleasant experience. The manager’s kindness and willingness to help a stranger really stood out to me. Thank you for being so welcoming and helpful — I’ll definitely remember this place the next time I’m in town!
Thanks to Ocean

They have always taken great care of our pup. He is very scared of all the grooming process and they have found ways to make it a little easier on him. We appreciate the dedication and love they pour onto him anytime he has a bath scheduled!

Ashley is simply the best -- truly one of the kindest, professional, caring dog groomers. Our dog, Jack, adores her, and has since he was a puppy. He literally runs into her arms. I highly recommend Doggie Style Pets Spruce for their selection of goods AND for their dog grooming services, specifically Ashley. THANKS to the team there for always caring for our Jack.
A great experience. My dog looked adorable and was very calm!

I'm embarrassed it took me this long to write this review because Doggie Style Pets is such an obvious five-star business. I've been making a conscious effort to show love to the local places that make our neighborhood special, and this one absolutely deserves it.

I've been bringing my dog Archie here for grooming for nearly four years, and I've never had a bad experience. The groomers do an excellent job, and Archie always comes out looking great, happy, and proud of his fresh haircut. He has a lot of energy and isn't always the easiest customer, but the team is patient, thoughtful, and clearly cares about the animals they work with. When Archie was a puppy, he would get nervous walking past the store. These days, he's largely outgrown that fear and seems to know that his glow-up is worth the trip.

I've compared their grooming prices with those of larger chains like PetSmart and found Doggie Style's pricing fair and competitive. What sets them apart is that you're supporting a local Philadelphia business that genuinely takes the time to get to know its customers and pets.

Beyond grooming, the store carries a great selection of treats, food, toys, shampoo, and other pet supplies. The staff is knowledgeable, approachable, and always willing to answer questions. They also frequently have rescue dogs available for adoption, which is always a highlight and a wonderful resource for anyone looking to add a dog to their family.

One thing I'd recommend is booking grooming appointments in advance. Their reputation is well deserved, and appointments can fill up a few weeks out. I've always appreciated that they'll sometimes call when an earlier opening becomes available.

We've recommended Doggie Style Pets to countless people over the years. People regularly stop us at the dog park or on neighborhood walks to compliment Archie and ask where he gets groomed. Doggie Style Pets on Spruce is always our recommendation.

In a city full of options, it's the rare business that earns your trust year after year. Doggie Style Pets has done exactly that.

Thank you for taking such great care of Archie over the years. We're lucky to have you in the neighborhood!
great grooming and incredibly efficient. Nice inventory also.

Great grooming. Bath special is perfect. And do a great job with nail grinding. Hannah H is fantastic. My puppy loves the store and all the staff who work here. He runs in and visits them behind the counter.
Ashley G is such an amazing groomer! My dog definitely had a great stress-free grooming experience. Also much quicker (and better) than I expected! 🐾🐾🐶🐶 …
Really nice people working here. I’m a volunteer driver for animal control and they were so friendly and appreciative, and welcomed the dog expertly, made her feel right at home. Great experience.

This was the single worst dog grooming we have ever had. Our Mini Schnauzer was cut in 2 places with blood dried on ear. There was zero attention to detail around face and ears and at a cost of $138 is absolutely insane. We should not have had to pay and you should absolutely not use this groomer. Owner should contact us for a refund, I am appalled at how poorly the grooming experience was. Stay away!
The dogs look beautiful, and they were super happy, what a great experience. Customer service is outstanding and the Groomers are the best around. Love being back in the city so I’m close by again!

0 for grooming services. Last year I dropped my dog off and when I picked her up she was covered in another dog’s fur and dirty (my dog is short haired, no fur). So dirty I had to profusely apologize to my Uber driver for destroying his back seat. The owners offered a free groom, I refused. 0 for customer service, there’s a brown girl who RAN up to me asking if I needed help as soon as I walked to the dog food. Then RAN to the counter to check me out, this isn’t friendly or courteous customer service. It’s giving discrimination and you look wild for yelling “ARE YOU READY TO CHECKOUT”. There’s another shop on Chestnut that’s just as good in selection.
The team is always excellent to work with, especially Ashley G! Her grooming skills are next to none and she does a great job of keeping my dogs calm and happy along the way.

I wanted to give this business a fair chance, so I visited twice. Unfortunately, both times I experienced rude front desk service and inconsistent grooming quality with little attention to styling. I still left a generous tip, but we won’t be returning.

I’ve never dealt with such an incompetent dog grooming store.
You schedule a follow-up appointment at check in- doesn’t go into the system.
You schedule by calling - doesn’t go into the system.
You then schedule via their online portal a then day of they decide to cancel an appointment.

How hard it is to run a business? I’ve been coming here for almost a year now and it’s a constant battle just to get a damn dog groomed
Love bringing my dog here. She always looks great.
Doggie style offers a terrific canine experience. My dog, who is a pain in the neck, loves going there. And he looks terrific afterward. Thank you, Doggie Style!

I’ve been coming here for years and I typically have a good experience except for this last time getting my golden doodle groomed. It had been about 3 hours since dropping her off and they never text me when she’s done (which is weird) so finally I called them and they told me yep she’s done. So I drive straight over and proceeded to wait for 25 minutes for them to bring my dog down which annoyed me because I was late for another appointment. Finally the cashier went up to grab her and came down with a different leash on my dog explaining that my dog had chewed through her leash. My dog is almost 5 and has NEVER chewed through a leash, random objects, shoes, etc. so it was strange. Did they have her locked up in a room unsupervised for an hour? The leash was bloody where she chewed it. I was running late anyways so I asked if I could just take the leash that they brought her down in because I literally didn’t have a usable leash. The cashier told me no and when I pushed she asked if I could bring the leash back after I was done. Like you clearly left my dog unsupervised and now without a leash, the least you could do is give me a leash to leave with. I think it’s unacceptable to leave my dog unsupervised with her leash on for god knows how long while I’m literally downstairs waiting for 25 minutes. And on top of that, doesn’t have the customer service decency to just give me a freaking leash after their negligence.
They had just what I needed and the staff was so friendly and helpful!!

Amazing grooming experience! Ashley G is a true professional, very competent, fast and thorough. She listened to what i wanted and did it! Full wash and cut in only an hour, wow! Doggie Style is really well run. the staff are very nice and attentive.
Absolutely love Jackie! She kind, sweet and really fast but excellent!

I frequent this location and have always had a positive experience except for today. Today Rachel M was hovering over me while I looked for the proper size shoes for my pup, and was lingering next to me pretending to do things while I shopped, it made me feel as though I was being watched, I grabbed one more item, paid and left.
Ollie visited the store for a bath and came out beautiful!  I was very happy!
Rumson looked good. But I suspect he was treated roughly. He wanted to run after the appointment. And he wanted to get the smell off he kept rolling in leaves. Also his anus area was red.

I stumbled up this store on a weekend trip to the city. I was just browsing and the attendant struck up conversation with me and was super informative about products specific to my dogs needs and age. We discussed better quality foods and she even gave me a sample of annamaet. Everything i brought back my Sassy loved! Shes 12 and ive been very mindful what I give her to live her happiest and healthiest. Thank you !!!
Super helpful staff, particularly Mo! They’re great to ask questions if you want to know more about ingredients and food options.
Rachel was really helpful! Thanks so much.
The Doggie Style stores are wonderful and the people are always so nice!!!

My dog fared very well at\y his first visit to Doggie Style Pets Spruce. He was taken in on time and completed on time. He looks great! I rated the experience 4 rather than 5 stars because I was unaccustomed to paying the fee that I was charged. However, the increase may well be attributable to our move from a suburb to Center City Philadelphia.
Liz is the best!!

My main problem with doggy style pets is that they take very adoptable sweet dogs from ACCT and jack up the adoption price from $70 to $500.
They don’t even want these dogs to get adopted out. They just want to profit off then. There’s so many people who would adopt these sweet puppies, but increasing the adoption fee by more than 400% is disgusting and exploitative. They would rather leave these puppies sitting in a 4 x 4 box than let them get taken home by a loving family.

they did a really great job with cocoa! both ladies working there were very kind and the groomer said cocoa was mostly well-behaved, which surprised me bc most places say she screams and screams and screams, haha.

the location is so convenient, as well. i think we'll definitely be coming back! 🫶🏻
Great job cutting Eddie's (cat) nails today!  Quick & painless. Very professional!

I came here to get my cat groomed. They did an ok job and I had to warn them before that he can be very loud. Not aggressive; he just cries a lot.
A girl named Ashley groomed him and when she brought him out to us, her first words were “Has he ever been groomed before?” in a very aggressive tone. The whole time she was talking to us she seemed very rude and aggressive which was really difficult for us because we already struggle maintaining our cat’s coat because he has very long, thick fur. Wasn’t the best experience. Might shop here again but wouldn’t do the grooming again.
Everyone was very nice especially Elizabeth! She done such a good job on Bella. She came in matted and lil stinky but left out clean and fresh! Thank y'all so much! But I will be coming back!
Love it,precise and on time and Cane never looked so cute
Great grooming

I came here for Grooming with a double coated reactive dog and the staff was amazing!!! Elizabeth took time to talk to me about my nerves and my dog liked her right away! He looked great when I picked her up and there were other dogs in the store so they arranged it so that he would have the least amount of interaction! 100% recommend!
Always super dog friendly, communicative, courteous, and my little girl has another great grooming.
Friendly staff and atmosphere. My dog got a nice nail grinding at an inexpensive rate.

Doggie Style Pets did a great job on our pup, Bubba. He looks amazing and you can tell just how well he was cared for during his bath. We are very happy with Doggie Style. Everyone there is always pleasant and welcoming.
Good groomers there.
My dog loves the selection of bones on the wall. He loves to shop there💛 We love his new raincoat!! Its  our everyday stop. Thank you for being part of the neighborhood! …
Great staff very friendly and helpful!

I cannot say enough great things about Doggie Style Pets Spruce! I’ve brought my dog here for grooming for a little over a year after being told by another groomer that my dog was too big. From the first visit into the store, we have had nothing but positive experiences and it’s one of his favorite places to walk over to (aka get a cookie/ice cream and a drink of water). Ashley does an amazing job with Theo’s grooming and I feel comfortable knowing I’m leaving my big guy in capable and caring hands. I truly appreciate the care that everyone working at Doggie Style has for animals and the overall welcoming environment. The store is well stocked and I can always rely on them to have the specific bag of Hill’s dog food I need, a clean atmosphere, and knowledgeable answers to all of my questions. Thank you Doggie Style!

I am writing to express my deep disappointment with the service my puppy and I received during our recent visit to your Spruce Street salon. Having been a loyal customer at your Pine Street location for months, I have always appreciated the professionalism and care provided there, which makes this experience all the more upsetting.

From the moment I arrived, the experience was unacceptable. The receptionist displayed an unprofessional attitude, and the groomer came out and yanked my puppy’s leash out of my hand without any introduction or acknowledgment. This lack of basic courtesy is not only unprofessional but also incredibly unsettling for me and my puppy.
Everyone is above kind and professional. Jacki is a wonderful groomer who listens  to what you want and  does it.  El always walks out happy. Doggie Style is a wonderful place to take you pup.
Ashley is the best
My ONLY pet store I will shop at for my kitten! Carmen and staff is awesome! Great recommendations and they have samples for your fur baby to try something new! 10/10

Convenient for shopping but DO NOT USE FOR GROOMING.  Cut all hair off and injured my dog and no one responded to my complaint.  They constantly lose experienced groomers and replace with novices who do not know what they are doing.

I visit both the Spruce and Fairmount stores. Staff are always friendly and helpful and there's lots of treats, toys, and pet supplies. My dog is groomed by Ashley at Spruce and she's amazing, my dog emerges happy and looking great!

I adopted a dog and asked first if it would go in a crate when I was out. I was told yes and I should do that. I spent a few hundred dollars getting stuff for the dog and when I put it in a crate it immediately started howling and barking even though I was sitting right next to it. I tried several times but same thing happened. I returned the dog and donated all the stuff. I live in an apt and I couldn’t subject my neighbors to that. The $450 adoption fee was not refunded to me and I’m now in a dispute with them. Miserable experience.
Very friendly staff, my Ebony was treated very gentle & with care while getting her nails trimmed 😺🐾 …
Zeus Loves it there! Awesome staff!
This is such a great store! Everything about it is just wonderful. Keep up the good work.

I’m so glad I found Imani to cut my doodle’s hair! We have been seeing her since we moved to Philly a year ago and she’s continues to do a great job! Also, everyone who works at this store has been so nice in assisting us.
